items.description: A historical military fortification on the Lacuy Peninsula that controlled maritime access to Chiloé.
facts: Part of Chiloé's Spanish defense network.

items.description: A classic colonial house in the heart of Santiago, once the residence of a governor and now serving as a historical museum.
facts: Now houses the Museum of Santiago.

items.description: The most important Spanish fortress of the Valdivia estuary, crucial for protecting southern Chile in the 17th century.
facts: Controlled the mouth of the Valdivia River.
Part of one of the largest fort systems in the Americas.
